home.subtitle: Composition and trend across personal and institutional debts.
home.categoryStackDescription: Percentage of total owed by category, month-by-month ({{currency}}).
home.categoryPieDescription: Share of what is currently owed by category ({{currency}}).

personal.title: Personal liabilities
personal.description: Informal debts — money owed to family, friends, or other individuals.

institutional.title: Institutional liabilities
institutional.description: Formal debts — mortgages, bank loans, outstanding credit-card balances.

emptyBody: Create your first {{subtype}} liability to start tracking month-end balances.
createDescription: Track a debt your household owes. Personal liabilities are informal (family, friends); institutional are formal (mortgage, bank loan, credit-card balance).
editDescription: Subtype and currency can't be changed. To use different ones, create a new liability. Ownership can be changed.
snapshotsEmpty: No snapshots yet. A snapshot is the value on your statement at month-end. Record one each month.

tour.overviewBody: Track what you owe over time — the balance lowers your net worth until it's paid off.
tour.actionsBody: Use “Edit” to change its details, “Close…” to mark it ended — it then stops counting toward your net worth — or “Delete” to remove it entirely.
tour.detailsBody: Principal, interest rate, term, and maturity were set when you added the liability. Use “Edit” to change them.
tour.chartBody: Each point is a month's balance owed, so you can watch the debt shrink.
tour.snapshotsBody: Each row is one month's balance owed. Tap “Record snapshot” to add this month's balance, or “Import” for several months at once.
